about.heading: Know Who
about.description: Hi, I'm Malik from Yemen. I graduated from Yarmouk University in Jordan and I'm a passionate Front-End Developer with 3 years of experience in building clean, user-friendly web interfaces.
about.focus: I'm specialized in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a solid understanding of modern frameworks like React and Next.js. My main focus is designing and building clean, responsive code to deliver smooth, high-quality user experiences across all devices.
about.arabwdoss: I currently work as a React Developer at ArabWare Dos, where I use my skills to build digital solutions. My experience includes developing key platforms and applications such as:
about.bank: Creating responsive interfaces for major corporate websites, including the Bin Dowal Bank website, which focuses on providing Islamic microfinance services.
about.wallet: Developing the Bin Dowal E-Wallet website — Yemen’s leading electronic payment gateway — using HTML, Tailwind CSS, and ReactJS.
about.baligne: Designing modern, responsive dashboard systems like the Ballighni app dashboard, which offers a smooth workflow for employees and features real-time data fetching from APIs.
about.responsive: I'm dedicated to delivering technical solutions that not only meet functional requirements but also ensure optimal accessibility and responsiveness across all devices.
